findings.description: The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Objects written to this archive are not required by this Terraform configuration to use a customer-managed KMS key, weakening protection and key-use control for archived report data.

The bucket defines a private ACL but no default server-side encryption configuration. Private access control does not protect stored ledger exports if encryption controls are absent or not enforced at the bucket.

Versioning and access logging are configured, but no default server-side encryption is configured for stored model artifacts. The configuration therefore does not enforce encryption or customer-managed key protection for new objects.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Runbook contents are not protected by an encryption requirement enforced by this Terraform configuration.
